// Orbit's opt-in text selection snapshot compatibility for MyGo 9c69cf829ece.
// Original MyGo is MIT licensed; see LICENSE. This addition does not retain UI
// nodes or change default Selectable semantics. See README.md for attribution.
package ui

import (
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

type retainedTextScope struct {
	identity string
	frame    uint64
	pass     int
}

// RetainTextSelection preserves an immutable snapshot of the currently mounted
// paragraphs when a selection starts, so virtual-list unmount does not erase
// Copy or highlights when those paragraphs return. It is opt-in on a Selectable
// container. Call every frame with a stable session/document identity; changing
// identity, removing/disabling the scope, or clicking outside clears it. Drag
// extension is limited to the initial snapshot, not newly mounted paragraphs.
// Snapshot text is never updated by a later edit, and no row/layout is retained.
func (e Element) RetainTextSelection(identity string) Element {
	n := e.node()
	if n == nil || n.kind != kindBox {
		return e
	}
	n.Selectable()
	rt, s := n.c.rt, n.st
	if s.retainedText == nil || s.retainedText.identity != identity {
		if rt.selection.scope == s.id {
			rt.selection = textSelection{}
		}
		s.retainedText = &retainedTextScope{identity: identity}
	}
	s.retainedText.frame, s.retainedText.pass = rt.frame, rt.pass
	return e
}

func (rt *engine) retainsTextSelection(scope uint64) bool {
	s := rt.states[scope]
	if s == nil || s.seen != rt.frame || s.pass != rt.pass || s.retainedText == nil || s.retainedText.frame != rt.frame || s.retainedText.pass != rt.pass || s.flags&flagUnselectable != 0 {
		return false
	}
	for p := s; p != nil; p = rt.states[p.parent] {
		if p.flags&(flagDisabled|flagInvisible|flagInert) != 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (rt *engine) captureRetainedTextSelection() {
	if rt.selection.blocks != nil || !rt.retainsTextSelection(rt.selection.scope) {
		return
	}
	for _, s := range rt.texts {
		if s.textScope == rt.selection.scope && s.editor != nil {
			rt.selection.blocks = append(rt.selection.blocks, SelectedText{ID: s.id, Text: s.editor.source})
		}
	}
}

func (rt *engine) retainedSelectedTexts() []SelectedText {
	a, b, selected := rt.textSelectionBounds()
	if !selected {
		return nil
	}
	first, last := rt.textPointIndex(a), rt.textPointIndex(b)
	parts := make([]SelectedText, 0, last-first+1)
	for i := first; i <= last; i++ {
		part := rt.selection.blocks[i]
		part.Start, part.End = 0, utf8.RuneCountInString(part.Text)
		if i == first {
			part.Start = min(a.at, part.End)
		}
		if i == last {
			part.End = min(b.at, part.End)
		}
		parts = append(parts, part)
	}
	return parts
}

func (rt *engine) copyRetainedTextSelection() bool {
	parts := rt.retainedSelectedTexts()
	nonempty := false
	for _, p := range parts {
		nonempty = nonempty || p.Start < p.End
	}
	if !nonempty {
		return false
	}
	if scope := rt.states[rt.selection.scope]; scope != nil && scope.copyData != nil {
		rt.host.writeClipboardData(scope.copyData(parts))
		return true
	}
	var text []string
	for _, p := range parts {
		if p.Start < p.End {
			text = append(text, string([]rune(p.Text)[p.Start:p.End]))
		}
	}
	if len(text) > 0 {
		rt.host.writeClipboard(strings.Join(text, "\n"))
	}
	return len(text) > 0
}

func (rt *engine) syncRetainedTextSelection() {
	if !rt.retainsTextSelection(rt.selection.scope) {
		rt.selection = textSelection{}
		return
	}
	scope := rt.states[rt.selection.scope]
	if !rt.selection.dragging {
		if focused := rt.states[rt.focused]; focused != nil && focused.textScope == scope.id {
			rt.focused = scope.id
		}
	}
	// A virtualized endpoint's state can be recycled. Move only the focus/capture
	// to its owning scope before pruning, never retain the endpoint state itself.
	if focused := rt.states[rt.focused]; rt.focused == rt.selection.anchor.id || rt.focused == rt.selection.caret.id {
		if focused == nil || focused.seen != rt.frame || focused.pass != rt.pass {
			rt.focused = scope.id
		}
	}
	if rt.selection.dragging && rt.pressed != nil && (rt.pressed.seen != rt.frame || rt.pressed.pass != rt.pass) {
		rt.pressed = scope
		scope.pressed = true
	}
	if rt.selection.dragging && rt.pressed != nil {
		rt.moveTextSelection(rt.pointerX, rt.pointerY)
	}
	a, b, selected := rt.textSelectionBounds()
	if !selected {
		return
	}
	first, last := rt.textPointIndex(a), rt.textPointIndex(b)
	for _, s := range rt.texts {
		if s.textScope != rt.selection.scope || s.editor == nil {
			continue
		}
		i := rt.textPointIndex(textPoint{id: s.id})
		if i < first || i > last {
			continue
		}
		from, to := 0, s.editor.buf.n
		if i == first {
			from = min(rt.currentRetainedOffset(s, a), to)
		}
		if i == last {
			to = min(rt.currentRetainedOffset(s, b), to)
		}
		s.editor.anchor, s.editor.caret = from, to
	}
}

// The retained scope follows Orbit's block-boundary gutter hit test, not the
// default nearest-glyph Euclidean test. Layout is always current, never cloned.
func (rt *engine) retainedTextSelectionAt(scope uint64, x, y float32) textPoint {
	var nearest *state
	distance := inf
	for _, s := range rt.texts {
		if s.textScope != scope || s.vw <= 0 || s.vh <= 0 || !s.editor.laidOut() {
			continue
		}
		r := intersect(transformRect(s.world, Rect{s.x, s.y, s.w, s.h}), Rect{s.vx, s.vy, s.vw, s.vh})
		if r.W <= 0 || r.H <= 0 {
			continue
		}
		dx, dy := max(r.X-x, x-r.X-r.W, 0), max(r.Y-y, y-r.Y-r.H, 0)
		if d := dx + dy; nearest == nil || d < distance {
			nearest, distance = s, d
		}
	}
	if nearest == nil {
		return textPoint{}
	}
	return textHit(nearest, x, y)
}

// Retained offsets follow the source snapshot's UTF-8 byte boundaries, while
// MyGo editors use runes. Convert through byte boundaries after live rewrites.
func selectionByteAtRune(text string, offset int) int {
	if offset <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	for i := range text {
		if offset == 0 {
			return i
		}
		offset--
	}
	return len(text)
}
func selectionRuneAtByte(text string, offset int) int {
	offset = max(0, min(offset, len(text)))
	for offset > 0 && offset < len(text) && !utf8.RuneStart(text[offset]) {
		offset--
	}
	return utf8.RuneCountInString(text[:offset])
}
func (rt *engine) snapshotTextPoint(p textPoint) textPoint {
	if rt.selection.blocks == nil {
		return p
	}
	i := rt.textPointIndex(p)
	s := rt.states[p.id]
	if i >= 0 && s != nil && s.editor != nil {
		p.at = selectionRuneAtByte(rt.selection.blocks[i].Text, selectionByteAtRune(s.editor.source, p.at))
	}
	return p
}
func (rt *engine) currentRetainedOffset(s *state, p textPoint) int {
	i := rt.textPointIndex(p)
	if i < 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return selectionRuneAtByte(s.editor.source, selectionByteAtRune(rt.selection.blocks[i].Text, p.at))
}

// retainedTextInteraction stores only IDs and build stamps, never node pointers.
type retainedTextInteraction struct {
	scope, frame uint64
	pass         int
}

// RetainTextSelectionInteraction lets a designated non-text navigation control
// interact without clearing this retained selection. Call every build on its
// shell with the live retained scope from the SAME window. Only pointer hits
// inside this shell qualify; ordinary controls/outside clicks remain unchanged.
func (e Element) RetainTextSelectionInteraction(scope Element) Element {
	n := e.node()
	if n == nil {
		return e
	}
	owner := scope.nodeFor(n.c.rt)
	if owner == nil || !n.c.rt.retainsTextSelection(owner.id) {
		return e
	}
	if n.st.retainedTextInteraction == nil {
		n.st.retainedTextInteraction = new(retainedTextInteraction)
	}
	*n.st.retainedTextInteraction = retainedTextInteraction{owner.id, n.c.rt.frame, n.c.rt.pass}
	return e
}
func (rt *engine) retainedTextInteractionHit(chain []uint64) bool {
	if rt.selection.blocks == nil || !rt.retainsTextSelection(rt.selection.scope) {
		return false
	}
	for _, id := range chain {
		s := rt.states[id]
		if s == nil || s.seen != rt.frame || s.pass != rt.pass {
			continue
		}
		p := s.retainedTextInteraction
		if p == nil || p.frame != rt.frame || p.pass != rt.pass || p.scope != rt.selection.scope {
			continue
		}
		valid := true
		for parent := s; parent != nil; parent = rt.states[parent.parent] {
			if parent.flags&(flagDisabled|flagInvisible|flagInert) != 0 {
				valid = false
				break
			}
		}
		if valid {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
